summary: Cosine::built_distance divided by arbitrarily small nonzero norm products and left the computed cosine unclamped, allowing floating-point rounding to produce distances outside [0, 1], including negative values. The fix requires the divisor to exceed f32::EPSILON and clamps cosine to [-1, 1] before computing (1 - cos) / 2. The exact implementation reversal is identifiable, but no detecting upstream test was established: the fix adds no tests, and inspection of existing cosine reader and writer tests found no demonstrated trigger for this numerical regression. Leave the candidate blocked pending a detecting upstream test; no builds or tests were run.
